name: Generic submission checklist
note: A general list, not any authority's. Choose your authority's list when there is one, and check its own published requirements.

items.title: Application form
items.detail: The authority's own application form, filled in and signed.

items.title: Proof of ownership or authority to apply
items.detail: A title deed, ownership certificate or the owner's written authority, as the authority asks.

items.title: Application fee
items.detail: The fee or proof that it was paid.

items.title: Site plan
items.detail: The site with its boundaries, north, the street, and the proposed and existing buildings.

items.title: Elevations
items.detail: Each outside face of the building.

items.title: Sections
items.detail: At least one section through the building.

items.title: Door schedule
items.detail: The doors with their sizes and types.

items.title: Window schedule
items.detail: The windows with their sizes and types.

items.title: Structural drawings
items.detail: Foundations, framing and structural details where the authority asks for them.

items.title: Drainage drawings
items.detail: Drains and connections where the authority asks for them.
